candidates.titulo: Muse has a voice mode now
candidates.resumen:

candidates.titulo: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
candidates.resumen:
Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use.

candidates.titulo: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
candidates.resumen: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

candidates.titulo: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
candidates.resumen: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

candidates.titulo: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent
candidates.resumen:
Airbnb plans to roll out an AI agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan and book travel, the company said in its Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter released today.

candidates.titulo: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
candidates.resumen: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

candidates.titulo: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
candidates.resumen: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

candidates.titulo: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
candidates.resumen: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. candidates.titulo: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
candidates.resumen:
OpenAI is launching GPT-6 Cyber, the latest version of its cybersecurity AI model, which it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms in the process. candidates.titulo: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
candidates.resumen: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.
